scope: Rejected before opening test: the calibration gates failed at every declared threshold below 1.0; misspelled inputs whose readings are both misspellings of known words (such as a misspelled репортаж ending in the ж key) are ambiguous by the corpus's rule and the model still decided them with scores up to 0.999995. The held-out test of keyswitch:boundary-v2:20260925:candidate4 was not read. No threshold, gate, development or calibration row was changed after this result.

config.evidence_scope: New synthetic segmentation supervision from frozen public reference lexicons; lexical features and alternative valid readings are computed with the lexicon the engine serves (onboard lexicons plus the packaged supplement). A misspelling drops one key other than the last, is categorised like a correctly spelled word, is followed by one literal suffix drawn from the same set, and is kept only when no reading of the typed keys is a known word; where no reading is a known word, every reading that such a misspelling makes of a known word is a valid intended output too. Partition by four physical leading keys before punctuation variants. New test families exclude the entire previously consumed public phrase-source vocabulary (including the boundary-v1 reserve and prefix corpus); the same lexical resources may know held-out words. These families have not trained this candidate. Earlier boundary-v2 splits (keyswitch:boundary-v2:20260907:candidate1, whose test was exposed, and keyswitch:boundary-v2:20260925:candidate2, rejected on calibration before its test was read, and keyswitch:boundary-v2:20260925:candidate3, superseded by this recipe before its test was read) partitioned the same lexicon words differently, so these families overlap their train, development, calibration and test. This is not independent real-user intent or a new test of the context or prefix models. Fresh test opened only after sealing weights and a calibration-selected threshold. Old private/audit and published examples are regression cases, not held-out evidence.
